fields.statement: Verifier, attempt 2, at 3ef516fe (a fixer commit that only changes the model). (2) TestReadBudget (budget_test.go, not touched by this change set) ran past the timeout at VM load average about 14. make self-check fails only on the verifier's own untracked actor record, which needs render.
